description:
Forming a multidisciplinary team for NASA Space Apps 2026.

Already on the team: • Backend — C#/.NET, APIs • Data Engineer — data processing & pipelines • Support/Generalist — integration, testing & helping across roles

Looking for: • Frontend — web UI & data visualization • Data Analyst — analysis, statistics & interpreting results • Business/Product — domain understanding, problem framing & presentation

Everyone will learn the relevant domain together. Looking for collaborative people who are willing to learn and contribute.
